subject: Upgrading from 0.6-12 to 0.6-14: change in SRMR and no more WRMR

messages.author: 08e48595b188026f
messages.subject: Upgrading from 0.6-12 to 0.6-14: change in SRMR and no more WRMR
parts:
Dear lavaan community,

I was estimating a path model where the dependent variable is dichotomous so I was using the WLSMV estimator. After updating from 0.6-12 to 0.6-14 I noticed that when usingmimic = "mplus"  the WRMR is no longer reported and that values of SRMR were slighlty different (0.006 before update and 0.003 after). Anyone has any ideas why this is so? Cannot find anything in version history...

Thanks!
Jošt

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Upgrading from 0.6-12 to 0.6-14: change in SRMR and no more WRMR
parts: It is now 0.6-15 after some bug fixes.
when usingmimic = "mplus"  the WRMR is no longer reported

That hasn't been reported in the summary() for a long time (nor does Mplus anymore; see URL below), but it is still available from fitMeasures()

example(lavTables, echo=FALSE)
fitMeasures(fit, "wrmr") # 0.829
that values of SRMR were slighlty different (0.006 before update and 0.003 after).

Still in 0.6-15?  Not sure if a default changed, but see ?lavResiduals about all the possible options you can choose to get what Mplus reports:

https://www.statmodel.com/download/SRMR2.pdf   

And the ?lavResiduals help page References are very informative about distinguishing between SRMR and CRMR (I think Mplus uses the SRMR formula for variances but CRMR formula for covariances/correlations, but that may have changed).
